banner.title: 3 days in Aruba
banner.detail: round trip · Thu Apr 29 – Sun May 2

scenes.text: Thursday, April 29. You leave El Dorado airport in Bogotá with your suitcase, heading to Aruba.
A two-hour direct flight with Wingo, round trip for 645 thousand pesos.
Day one: relax on Eagle Beach, under the famous fofoti trees.

media.credit: Jason Boldero / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0

scenes.text: Day two: rent a car, it's cheaper than taxis, and drive through Arikok National Park to the natural pool.

media.credit: Bjørn Christian Tørrissen / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

scenes.text: Day three: go snorkeling in the calm waters of Mangel Halto.
And to finish, climb the California Lighthouse to watch the sunset.
Sunday, May 2: you land back at El Dorado, and you only took two days off work.

caption:
3 days in Aruba: Wingo flights for COP 645,976 round trip, direct from Bogotá, Thursday April 29 to Sunday May 2. Relax on Eagle Beach, explore Arikok National Park by 4x4 and go snorkeling at Mangel Halto. Tip: the island is expensive; renting a car is usually cheaper than taxis. Check the flight details on our website.
